summary: Unpinned github: dependency source resolves to a mutable branch at install time
details: package.json declares `libsignal` as `github:Cogils/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity check. On `npm install`, npm resolves this to whatever the default branch of that GitHub repository currently points at and executes any lifecycle scripts contained within the fetched tree. The owner of that repository can change the installed code at any time without any version change in @sakataa/baileys, and no registry-side immutability or audit applies. This is an off-registry dependency source: the manifest line itself causes attacker-mutable code to be fetched and run in the installer's environment on a default install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
